title: Mango-Avocado Pesto Pasta Salad with Snap Peas, Edamame & Pine Nuts

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel mangos and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; medium dice and place half in a blender. Place the other half in a large bowl and set aside.
Halve and pit avocado; cut crosswise while still in the skin, scoop out with a spoon, and add to the blender with the mango.
Peel and mince garlic; pick basil leaves off the stems. Add both to the blender.

Juice lime into the blender; add water, oil, salt, and crushed red pepper. Blend on high until mango pesto is very smooth, adding water 1 tablespoon at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency; set aside.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the mango.
Halve snap peas and add to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise; add to the bowl.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; drain and add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and add to the bowl along with the mango pesto and pine nuts; stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
